name: Samara Doc Builder v1.8.0

meta.description: Added toggleable Samara Seal and fixed character mangling.

manifest.title: Samara_Doc_Builder
manifest.author: Samara Project
manifest.notes: Added Samara Seal valve. Enforced UTF-8 encoding. Safe-quoted to prevent syntax errors.

content:
""" title: Samara_Doc_Builder author: Samara Project version: 1.8.0 """ import os, re, datetime, base64, json from pydantic import BaseModel, Field class Action: class Valves(BaseModel): civic_header: str = Field(default="", description="District/Government Header.") enable_seal: bool = Field(default=False, description="Show the Samara Council Seal.") def __init__(self): self.valves = self.Valves() def _nowstamp(self): return datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d') def _slug(self, text: str): s = str(text).lower() s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s).strip('-') return s or 'chat' def _pdf_html(self, title: str, content_md: str, civic_info: str) -> str: # The Samara Seal (Minimalist SVG) seal_svg = '' if self.valves.enable_seal else '' header = f'
{seal_svg}
{civic_info}
' if civic_info or seal_svg else '' return f'
{header}

{title}

Date: {self._nowstamp()}
{content_md}
' async def action(self, body: dict, __user__=None, __event_emitter__=None, __event_call__=None): messages = body.get('messages', []) date_str = self._nowstamp() chat_topic = self._slug(body.get('title', 'transcript')) model_name = self._slug(body.get('model', 'local').split('/')[-1]) filename = f'{date_str}_{chat_topic}_{model_name}' src = '' for m in messages: if m.get('role') in ['user', 'assistant']: role = 'USER' if m['role'] == 'user' else 'SAMARA' src += f'\n### {role}\n{m["content"]}\n' html_doc = self._pdf_html(chat_topic.replace('-', ' ').title(), src, self.valves.civic_header) utf8_bytes = html_doc.encode('utf-8') b64 = base64.b64encode(utf8_bytes).decode('ascii') # Safe UTF-8 decoding bridge in JS js = f'const win = window.open("", "_blank"); win.document.write(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob("{b64}")))); win.document.title = "{filename}"; win.document.close();' await __event_call__({'type': 'execute', 'data': {'code': js}}) await __event_emitter__({'type': 'notification', 'data': {'type': 'success', 'content': f'Seal Applied: {filename}'}})
